caseName: Babbitt v. Planned Parenthood of Central & Northern Arizona
caseNameFull: Babbitt, Governor of Arizona v. Planned Parenthood of Central and Northern Arizona
judges: Con, Consideration, Jurisdiction, Set, Took, White, Would

opinions.text:
Affirmed on appeal from C. A. 9th Cir.

The Chief Justice, Justice White, and Justice Scalia would note probable jurisdiction and set the case for oral argument. Justice O’Con-nor took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
